function: Learns joint communication and sensing beamforming vectors of cooperative multi-BS ISAC to maximize sum-rate under per-BS power and localization (SPEB) constraints (pp. 5, 9)
system: 3 BSs each with 16-antenna UPA (4x4), 5 single-antenna users, 1 or 2 sensing targets, 28 GHz; no RIS (pp. 3, 10)
method: Link-heterogeneous GNN with graph attention (9 GNN, 2 fully connected layers); unsupervised training with a penalty loss on SPEB and per-user rate; 4000 samples, 800 epochs (pp. 8-10)
data_channel: DeepMIMO 'O1' outdoor ray-tracing scenario at 28 GHz, BSs 1-3, 5 random user positions per sample, fixed target positions; 4000 training samples (p. 10)
test_conditions: Trained on 4000 samples, fixed BSs and targets; evaluated over transmit power 12-24 dBm, SNR 0-30 dB, position error 0-7 m; separate test set not described (pp. 10-13)
baselines: Non-learned: SRW [5] (SCA-based iterative optimization); learned: Het GNN w/o Attn (ablation), Homo GNN w. Attn, Naive CNN w/o Attn (pp. 10, 12)
metrics: Achievable sum-rate, SPEB (position error bound), training curves of rate and SPEB, computation time versus antennas (pp. 10-13)
complexity: Total complexity O(EL^2)+O(Ed^2U)+O(VL^2U'); runtime versus number of antennas in Fig. 9 for all methods (p. 11)
openness: none released by the authors; uses the public DeepMIMO dataset, arXiv:1902.06435 (pp. 10, 14)
q1_support: p. 10: "DeepMIMO [23] dataset, which is based on accurate raytracing data" gives the communication CSI (O1 scenario, 28 GHz); the sensing link is an analytic LoS steering-vector model (p. 4).
q2_support: p. 10: "LHGNN is completed using IT = 4000 training data points" on DeepMIMO O1 with fixed BSs and targets; performance is only swept over power, SNR and position error (pp. 11-12); Fig. 9 varies the antennas for runtime only, and no performance test uses another scenario or band.
q3_support: p. 10: "SRW [5]: In this algorithm, an iterative algorithm based" on SCA is the non-learned baseline and "Naive CNN w/o Attn: In this algorithm, CNNs are" used for the same beamforming is the learned one; both are compared on rate and SPEB (Figs. 10-11, pp. 11-12).
q4_support: p. 11: "the total complexity of LHGNN is" O(EL2)+O(Ed2U)+O(VL2U'); Fig. 9 reports the measured runtime of each algorithm versus the number of antennas.
q5_support: p. 10: "The training data is generated using the publicly available" DeepMIMO [23] dataset; the authors give no link to their own code.
notes: Sensing is localization through the SPEB constraint, but the learned output is the joint beamformer, hence area 5. q1 covers the communication CSI only. q3 rests on SRW (non-learned) and the Naive CNN (standard architecture); Het GNN w/o Attn and Homo GNN w. Attn are variants of the proposed method and are not counted. q2 is 0 because the paper describes no separate test set and the two-target case (p. 13) has its own training.
